newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai April wholesale prices up 0.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai April wholesale prices up 0.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) rose 0.9 percent year-on-year in April against a 1.1 percent increase in the previous month, the Commerce Ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry said wholesale prices rose 0.4 percent in April from March against a 0.1 percent month-on-month rise in the previous month.
The ministry said the 1985-based index rose to 155.9 in April from its 154.5 level in April 1996.
